body:
> Just for some background, the variable used to be `Set` (which I assume kept insertion order / sorted automatically like `RBSet`, and was changed to `RBSet` 5 years later (maybe around when `Set` was removed?). Then it was changed to `HashSet` when that got added, only for this to be reverted 3 years later to `RBSet` to fix the log rotation order.

`Set` is the old name of `RBSet`. When `HashSet` was introduced it is renamed to a clearer name.

> Exchanging `RBSet` for `LocalVector` makes sense in principle. But `RBSet` does have a guarantee that there are no duplicate entries. Logically, I can't see how that would be relevant when listing files in a folder.

No duplication is guranteed by OS (you can't have files with same name in one folder), I think that's probably fine.

> But I also don't feel comfortable approving this, since there is no practical motivation behind this PR other than to exchange an old type for a new one.

Like I said above, to make the code's intent clearer. Elems of  `RBSet` are sorted implicitly, one would suspect whether this side effect is wanted, while using `LocalVector` we call `sort` so it is clear we want this behaviour.
